summary: Full backend + frontend regression for VeriTrust AI. Backend: 20 pytest tests pass (auth register/login/me/update/duplicate/unauth, policy list/detail/dashboard/document, verify by id + by hash + 404, verification details, PDF report (magic bytes verified), AI ask + chat history, compare 404, full upload pipeline end-to-end in 55s producing real SHA-256 + IPFS CID + tx hash + multilingual explanations). Frontend: login, dashboard (all 6 stat/list/chart data-testids present, 2 policies, 48/100 avg risk), Policy History (search/filters/cards), Policy Detail (SHA-256, IPFS, risk gauge 48/Medium, breakdown chart, language toggle EN/HI/MR, voice player, blockchain VERIFIED, tabs), Ask AI page (policy selector + suggestions), Compare, Verification Center, Profile, Upload — all navigate; auth guard redirects unauthenticated users to /login. Uploaded a 2nd policy so demo now has 2 policies (enabling real compare testing).

issues: React hydration console warning: <span> inside <option> in the Selector <select>. Caused by Emergent dev-overlay injecting tracking spans into option children; safe to ignore in prod build but produces console noise in dev. If needed, render option label as a plain string (no children wrappers).

critical_code_review_comments: policy_routes.dashboard iterates policies twice with refresh calls — fine at small scale; consider eager loading (selectinload) for lists once policy volume grows.
extracted_text is truncated to 200000 chars before persistence and to 8000 chars when building the AI Q&A context — good, prevents context blow-up.
verify endpoint correctly recomputes SHA-256 from the IPFS-stored bytes for genuine tamper detection (verified matches=true in tests).

CORS uses allow_credentials=True together with allow_origins='*' default; browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Frontend uses Bearer header (no cookies) so not affected today, but tighten CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins for safety.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (auth.hash_password/verify_password) — good. JWT 30-day exp — acceptable.
PolicyCompare.jsx: rendered <span> inside <option> triggers React hydration warning (see design_issues).
test_credentials: demo@veritrust.ai / demo123 (JWT Bearer in localStorage key veritrust_token)
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a 2nd health policy 'TEST Upload Policy' via /api/policies/upload (real Claude analysis, ~55s). Demo user now has 2 policies, enabling end-to-end Compare testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; set RUN_UPLOAD=1 to include the ~55s full pipeline upload test. Data-testids: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, register-*-input, register-submit-button, dashboard-{total-policies,verified-policies,avg-risk,categories}-stat, dashboard-recent-policies-list, dashboard-risk-chart, dashboard-upload-cta, nav-link-{dashboard,upload,policies,compare,ask-ai,verify}, nav-user-menu-trigger (profile), nav-logout-button. Compare uses compare-policy-a/b selects (native <select>).
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. All backend endpoints return correct status codes and payload shapes; frontend renders and integrates with API correctly; auth protection enforced.
